questions.question: Country A: 10 labour hours for 1 cloth or 5 wine. Country B: 6 cloth or 4 wine. Who has comparative advantage in what?

points.text: A: OC 1 cloth = 2 wine (10/5), 1 wine = 0.5 cloth. B: OC 1 cloth = 0.67 wine (6/4), 1 wine = 1.5 cloth. B has CA in cloth (lower OC), A has CA in wine. A exports wine, B exports cloth. Both gain
